# Men's Health

> > Men's Health is the world's largest men's magazine brand delivering expert-backed guidance on fitness, nutrition, health conditions, sexual wellness, and lifestyle.

The site features workout programs and exercise form guides from certified trainers like Ebenezer Samuel (C.S.C.S.), comprehensive health condition resources including prostate cancer and erectile dysfunction information, and product recommendations across fitness gear, clothing brands like Huckberry and Bonobos, and wellness technology. Content is created by health journalists, registered dietitians, and medical professionals.

## Key Topics

- Muscle building and strength training
- Weight loss and fat loss strategies
- Erectile dysfunction and sexual health
- Beginner fitness and weight training
- Body recomposition techniques
- Prostate cancer awareness and treatment
- Mental health and longevity
- Nutrition advice and diet plans
- Workout routines and exercise form
- Bodyweight and calisthenics training
- Fitness tracking technology
- Men's Health MVP membership programs
- Expert trainers: Ebenezer Samuel (C.S.C.S.), Cori Ritchey (NASM)

## Core Sections

- [Men's Health - Fitness, Nutrition, Health, Sex, Style & Weight Loss Tips for Men](https://menshealth.com): Homepage featuring latest fitness, health, nutrition & lifestyle content
- [Fitness, Home Workouts, Before-and-After Transformations, and More](https://menshealth.com/fitness): Fitness section with workout routines, training tips & transformation stories
- [Health News and Advice for Healthy Living](https://menshealth.com/health): Health hub covering mental health, heart health, longevity & wellness
- [Nutrition, Healthy Eating, and Safe Diet Plans](https://menshealth.com/nutrition): Nutrition hub with recipes, diet plans & healthy eating strategies
- [Sexual Health](https://menshealth.com/sexual-health): Sexual health section covering ED, reproductive health & wellness
- [Health Conditions Hub](https://menshealth.com/health-conditions-hub): Medical hub covering prostate cancer, brain health & preventive care

## Training Guides and Workout Programs

- [Beginner's Guide to Weight Training to Build Muscle and Strength](https://menshealth.com/fitness/a27212209/beginners-guide-weight-training): No-nonsense beginner's weight training guide for muscle & strength
- [How to Build Muscle - Experts Share 10 Workout and Diet Tips](https://menshealth.com/fitness/a19534499/10-muscle-building-tips): Expert muscle-building guide covering workout & diet tips for beginners
- [Body Recomposition - How to Work Out to Build Muscle and Burn Fat](https://menshealth.com/fitness/a63227245/body-recomposition): Body recomp program to build muscle & lose fat simultaneously
- [Workouts – Exercise Routines And Moves to Build Muscle, Burn Fat](https://menshealth.com/workouts): Exercise routines for chest, biceps, legs with expert form guides
- [8-Week Ultimate Arm Training Plan, Workout, and Nutrition Guide](https://menshealth.com/fitness/a65255915/arm-workout-training-program): 8-week Ultimate Arm Recomp program with hypertrophy training & nutrition
- [Calisthenics: Everything You Need To know](https://menshealth.com/uk/building-muscle/a759641/complete-guide-to-calisthenics-everything-you-need-to-know): Complete calisthenics guide with bodyweight exercises & workout plans
- [Bodybuilding | A Complete Guide](https://menshealth.com/uk/building-muscle/a759236/complete-guide-to-bodybuilding): IFBB pro Ryan Terry's complete bodybuilding training & nutrition guide
- [The 45 Best Beginner Exercises to Do During Home Workouts](https://menshealth.com/uk/building-muscle/a754099/the-15-best-beginners-exercises-to-do-at-home): Beginner home workout guide with bodyweight & dumbbell exercises
